criteria.requirement: Fix attrs_plugin(spans=True, allowed=...) so _span_rule receives and applies the same _add_attrs filtering policy as supported links/images/code. Keep only allowed attributes on the real opening Token and rendered HTML while preserving rejected attributes in insecure_attrs metadata. None remains unrestricted and an empty sequence forbids all. Preserve nested spans, quoted attributes, parsing fallback and existing non-span filtering; do not disable spans or discard all attributes to pass the examples.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
